== Summary ==
Contemporary recipient photo of both foil slips for the Virtual Set 3 objective ''Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found''.

* Source: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1031590#p1031590 Original recipient post], 4 May 2016, embedded image.
* Original photo: [https://i.imgur.com/MOiEl0h.jpg?1 Recipient's native JPEG].
* Published size: 1,200 × 1,056 pixels. The front and reverse are visible together. Part of the rules text is obscured by overlapping slips and a hand.
